title: Orchestration rep record (practice plan v1.2)
description: One scored orchestration repetition. Schema mirrors the run card in vault skill-lab/2026-07-25-orchestration-mastery-practice-plan.md (v1.2). Compact subset is required always; full-comparison fields become required when comparison_mode is 'full' or 'audited_prediction'.

rung.description: calibration-1..4 (30-day cycle), R1..R6 (ladder), rep-zero (retrospective), or ad-hoc.

task_family.description: Drives Gate A item 2 (>=3 materially different task families).

protocol_rep.description: True if run under the v1.2 protocol. False for retrospectives (excluded from Gate A counts).

faculty.description: Axis 1 - practitioner faculty stressed. S1 verification, S2 decomposition/spec, S3 context, S4 delegation/architecture, S5 review, S6 trust/recovery.

surface.description: Axis 2 - lifecycle surface where the faculty was stressed or failed.

comparison_mode.description: full = both arms run. prediction_only = only chosen arm run. audited_prediction = eligible for prediction-only but randomly selected for a surprise baseline.

execution_mode.description: HOW the work was done (orthogonal to comparison_mode, which is how it was measured). delegated = agents did it, human reviewed. assisted = co-execution, agent drafts and human rewrites (Phase 0 third mode). solo = unaided, no agent in the loop at all — counts toward the P12 craft-practice floor.

pursuit.description: Which pursuit this served (e.g. job, investing, novel, learning, apparatus). Feeds dormancy tracking — plurality without forced abandonment.

apparatus_orchestrated.description: Apparatus work only (P6 / Codex amendment 4): true if the build itself was orchestrated under a verification design, which is what qualifies it as a scored rep. Hand-coded apparatus is false and stays unscored.

review_pressure.description: Reps 1-2 constraint experiment: is review capacity the ceiling on plurality?

switch_pressure.description: Reps 1-2 constraint experiment: is switching cost the ceiling instead?

architecture.description: Topology actually run (workflow / single agent / ensemble / manager-worker / handoff / no-AI).

rejected_alt.description: The simpler alternative considered and rejected, with the reason.

simple_baseline.description: Exact simpler system run, incl. its resource allowance. Required for full/audited.

compute_control.description: Compute-matched comparator, if the >=2x-inference trigger fired.

predicted_winner.description: Machine-checkable pre-run prediction. Pairs with observed_class to score calibration.

architecture_prediction.description: Free-text rationale: task properties driving the prediction.

primary_outcome.description: The single predeclared result being optimized. Required for full/audited.

meaningful_margin.description: Decision-flipping threshold, predeclared. Required for full/audited.

grader_type.description: outcome_check and human_blind count toward Gate A item 3 (external reviews).

grader_blinded.description: Was architecture identity hidden from the grader?

execution_order.description: Which arm ran first; records carryover risk.

observed_class.description: Required for full/audited. 'inconclusive' is first-class - never force it into a win column.

score.description: Faculty score against the v1.1 rubric anchors.

evidence.description: One line of transcript/artifact evidence justifying the score.

blind_grader_score.description: Fresh-context grader's score, recorded BEFORE the learner's. Disagreement is S1 data.

recovery_test.description: Phase B only - the bounded failure injected, after the clean comparison was captured.

tokens.description: Name the metric in token_metric — 'tokens' alone is ambiguous between output-only and input+cache+output, and the two differ by several multiples on pipeline topologies.

token_metric.description: Which token measure the tokens field holds. Added after reps 1-2 reported input_cache_output as if it were output, understating rep 2's orchestrated/simple ratio by 3.7x.

human_min.description: Setup + review + synthesis + rework. The metric that actually binds. Null ONLY when it was never instrumented, and then human_min_basis must say so — a guessed number here silently satisfies cost-based win conditions that were never measured.

human_min_basis.description: Provenance of human_min. Only 'measured' and 'contemporaneous_estimate' may support a cost-clause win; 'post_hoc_estimate' and 'unmeasured' force the comparison to inconclusive.

accepted_artifacts.description: Artifacts accepted this run; denominator for review-cost-per-accepted-artifact.

escaped_defects.description: Defects that survived review and were found later.

change.description: The one change to make next time.
